cards.name: Tribute to The Doomed
cards.description: Discard 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard to destroy 1 Monster Card on the field (regardless of its position).

cards.name: Magic Jammer
cards.description: Discard 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard to negate the activation of a Spell Card and destroy it.

cards.name: Final Destiny
cards.description: Discard 5 cards from your hand to destroy all the cards on the field.

cards.name: Darkness Approaches
cards.description: Discard 2 cards from your hand. Select 1 face-up monster and flip it face-down, but do not change its battle position.

cards.name: Big Shield Gardna
cards.description: When this card is face-down and targeted by a Spell Card whose effect targets only 1 monster the Spell Card is negated and this card is turned face-up in Defense Position. When this card is attacked, it is shifted to Attack Position following the Damage step.

cards.name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
cards.description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, both players must first Set Spell Cards when they use them and cannot activate them until their next turn.

method: Static resource/registration/instruction checks and hand eligibility model; no native execution.
limits: Selection UI, synchronization, negation/refunds and full interactions not dynamically tested.
